data.desc: Allied Gold is a Canadian-based gold producer with a significant growth profile and mineral endowment, operating four mines across Cote d'Ivoire, Mali, and Ethiopia, including the recently commissioned Kurmuk Mine. Led by a team of mining executives with extensive operational and development experience and a proven track record of value creation, Allied Gold aspires to become Africa's next-generation mid-tier gold producer and, ultimately, a leading senior global gold producer.
